notes.title: Game Official Release
notes.notes:
'Golden Castle' is officially released! I'm more than happy about this. 

Now what I will say is yes there is already a bug/issue that I know of that you can wall in/on walls/ceiling/etc. 

What I will say is I'm hard at work already to fix this issue right away as I didn't catch it until late yesterday as I'm just one person.

Just a reminder that I'm the only one that works on the games. Yep you heard that right, the whole company is made up entirely of one person. 

(Side note, I do have a job and work on this stuff as passion projects)

So I'm working hard to fix that, but if you come across any other errors, issues, or bugs please let me know and I will do my best to fix them as I'm already working on the map fixes.

Also thank you again for the support.
